map.粪便隐血定量：FIT 小于10 阴性、10–20 临界、20–100 阳性、不低: Fecal immunochemical test (FIT): <10 negative, 10–20 borderline, 20–100 positive, ≥100 strongly positive; combined with age and fecal calprotectin (FC) to assess colorectal lesion risk.
map.FIT阳性阈值因厂家而异（10-20 μg/g），年龄越大阳性预测值越高。FIT: The FIT positive threshold varies by manufacturer (10-20 μg/g), and the positive predictive value rises with age. FIT is immunological, specifically detecting human hemoglobin, and is unaffected by animal hemoglobin or iron supplements.
map.FC是中性粒细胞来源的钙结合蛋白，反映肠道炎症程度。不受上消化道出血影响（被降解: FC is a neutrophil-derived calcium-binding protein reflecting the degree of intestinal inflammation. It is unaffected by upper GI bleeding (degraded) and reflects lower GI inflammation more specifically than FIT.

map.提示：FIT和FC是互补的非侵入性标志物。FIT敏感检测下消化道出血（结直肠肿瘤: Note: FIT and FC are complementary non-invasive markers. FIT sensitively detects lower GI bleeding (colorectal tumor screening), while FC specifically reflects intestinal inflammation (IBD screening and follow-up). Combining the two improves differentiation efficiency. For clinical reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：大便潜血(FIT)定量与钙卫蛋白联合解读: 📚 Deep Dive: Fecal Occult Blood (FIT) Quantitation and Calprotectin Combined Interpretation
map.肠癌筛查：FIT 阳性优先排查结直肠肿瘤/息肉: Colorectal cancer screening: FIT positive prioritizes ruling out colorectal tumor/polyp
map.IBD 鉴别：FIT 阴而钙卫蛋白高提示肠道炎症: IBD differentiation: FIT negative with high calprotectin indicates intestinal inflammation
map.联合决策：双阳性尽快肠镜，双阴性风险低: Combined decisions: both positive warrants colonoscopy soon, both negative is low risk
map.算法：FIT <10 → 阴性、10~20 → 临界、20~100 → 阳性、≥: Algorithm: FIT <10 → negative, 10~20 → borderline, 20~100 → positive, ≥100 μg/mL → strongly positive; fecal calprotectin (FC) <50 → normal, 50~200 → mildly elevated, 200~500 → moderate, ≥500 μg/g → markedly elevated. Combined: FIT≥20 and FC<50 → bleeding positive, inflammation negative (prioritize tumor); FIT<10 and FC≥200 → bleeding negative, inflammation positive (prioritize IBD); FIT≥20 and FC≥200 → both positive (clarify with colonoscopy); both negative → low risk.
map.例：FIT 150 μg/mL（强阳）、FC 300 μg/g（中度升高）→ 双: Example: FIT 150 μg/mL (strongly positive), FC 300 μg/g (moderately elevated) → both positive, possibly IBD with bleeding or tumor with inflammation; prompt full colonoscopy plus biopsy is advised. If FIT 5 (negative), FC 300 (elevated) → bleeding negative, inflammation positive, indicating intestinal inflammation (not supporting IBS); colonoscopy plus biopsy to exclude IBD is advised. If FIT 50, FC 120 → both borderline (positive/mild); recheck in 2~4 weeks, and if persistently elevated, perform colonoscopy.
map.FIT 和钙卫蛋白能互相替代吗？: Can FIT and calprotectin substitute for each other?
map.不能。FIT 反映下消化道出血（肿瘤/息肉/活动性炎症均可阳性），钙卫蛋白反映肠: No. FIT reflects lower GI bleeding (tumor/polyp/active inflammation can all be positive), while calprotectin reflects intestinal neutrophil inflammation (sensitive for IBD). The two complement each other: strongly positive FIT prioritizes tumor workup, and high calprotectin with negative FIT prioritizes IBD workup.
map.FIT 阳性就一定是癌吗？: Does a positive FIT mean cancer?
map.不是。息肉、痔、结肠炎、溃疡、甚至饮食与药物都可使 FIT 升高。但 FIT 阳: No. Polyps, hemorrhoids, colitis, ulcers, even diet and medications can raise FIT. But a positive FIT (especially ≥20) counts as a positive colorectal cancer screening result and requires colonoscopy confirmation per protocol; follow-up alone is not acceptable.
